table.name: TLGNR_SIGNATURE_TYPE_BS
table.description: Used in the Shipto (Dispokarte) to define if a signature is mandatory, optional, or not needed.

column.name: SIGNATURE_TYPE_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 0=mandatory, 1=optional, 2=no signature.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
